Class ManningStricklerHydrodynamicsEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.engine.AbstractSimulationEngine
org.ether.society.engines.tier1.ManningStricklerHydrodynamicsEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
SimulationEngineModule
public class ManningStricklerHydrodynamicsEngine extends AbstractSimulationEngine
Open-Channel River Hydrodynamics & Floodplain Inundation Engine (Manning-Strickler Formula).

Models gravity-driven open-channel water velocity $v = \frac{1}{n} R_h^{2/3} S^{1/2}$ and alluvial floodplain silt deposition using smooth ($C^\infty$) functions of continuous elevation $z$ and meteoric/catchment runoff (AGENTS.md §3, §10.2), without discrete Biome slope switches.
